description: Enable and/or change default settings for 'headlamp' plugin

namespace.description: Namespace where Headlamp should be installed

releaseName.description: Release name for Headlamp helm chart. It is also used as a name of Headlamp Deployment, Service, Ingress, and HTTPRoute.

hostname.description: Address on which the Headlamp UI is located. Used in Ingress and HTTPRoute resources. Should differ from the 'kubernetes-dashboard' hostname if both plugins are installed.

headlampRegistry.description: Registry for Headlamp image. If empty, 'installation.registry' or 'ghcr.io' is used.

debugRegistry.description: Registry for the image of node shell pods and pod debug containers. If empty, 'installation.registry' is used, if specified.

debugImage.description: Image to use for node shell pods and pod debug containers

values.description: Override values for Headlamp helm chart
